view.title: The House Remembers
view.premise: A house rearranges itself around the things its inhabitants remember. Your sister Nell has vanished upstairs.

bedroom.name: The Blue Bedroom
bedroom.description: Rain against the glass. Nell's side of the bed is empty.

rowan.name: Rowan
rowan.description: Nell's older sibling. A patient listener with a practical streak.

brass-key.name: Brass key
brass-key.description: A small brass key. Its bow is shaped like a leaf.

crowbar.name: Old crowbar
crowbar.description: The iron end is narrow enough to prise a stubborn latch.

bed.name: Unmade bed
bed.description: Nell's quilt is folded back. It is still warm.

nell-letter.name: Nell's letter
nell-letter.description: The page reads: "I heard our song upstairs. Don't worry. N."

bedroom-chest.name: Cedar chest
bedroom-chest.description: An unlocked chest full of old letters.

keepsake.name: Keeper's locket
keepsake.description: The portrait inside matches the keeper in the hall.

dialogue.speaker: Rowan
dialogue.text: Nell's gone. I heard her humming somewhere upstairs. I have to find my sister.
